metadata.dataset: NCTA map-sheet footprints, full trail-wide set
metadata.source: NCTA per-state map-series GeoPDFs, https://northcountrytrail.org/maps/ (free downloads)
metadata.method: One Polygon per GeoPDF page carrying a /VP viewport; ring from the /Measure /GPTS corners (BL, BR, TR, TL). Sheet label from the printed title block. trail_miles_in_sheet = geodesic miles of the NCT centerline inside the quad.
metadata.note: The two Ohio series both number OH-001.. — sheet ids repeat across oh-northwest and oh-eastern; `series` is part of a sheet's identity.
